_extraction_context.snippet_primary: "Used to be handmade items, made with love and care. Now its just a platform for lots of rubbish from China which is incorrectly sized, poor material (unlikely to conform to UK H&S) and awful service. Have to pay through the nose to return items to other countries and no cover for items that go missing. Better off throwing money in the bin."
